rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something with affection and care.

example.english: They lovingly take care of stray cats.
example.traditional: 佢好有愛咁照顧啲流浪貓。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 jau5 oi3 gam2 ziu3 gu3 di1 lau4 long6 maau1

rows.note: Use this when the loving manner is especially tender or gentle, particularly for touching, holding, or speaking to someone.

example.traditional: 佢好溫柔咁抱住個嬰兒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 wan1 jau4 gam2 pou5 zyu6 go3 jing1 ji4
